title: Loupe
description: A Beatles sleeve on a black ground under a collector's loupe in a low sun. The glass throws its shadow on the cover and burns the light to a hot point beside it, with a cone of rays and a coloured caustic ring; turn it from 2× to 20× and the cover comes apart into CMYK rosettes.
intent: One optical object finished to the edge: real glass with refraction, chromatic fringe and a focused hot spot over a real print, where magnification turns a cover into the ink it is made of.
